name: NCAA D-III South Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Earlysville, VA · host Lynchburg · Panorama Farms
headline: NCAA D-III South Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 11 Washington and Lee won the men’s race with 26 points, placing four in the top five, ahead of No. 27 Lynchburg (70); Matt Kelly (24:42.4) beat teammate Sam Daunt by a tenth of a second. No. 14 Emory won the women’s title with 59 points over Catholic (114) and Christopher Newport (123), and Batten’s Ester Zar won the women’s race by 38.8 seconds in 21:09.6.
